pilots.name: Luis Taz
nights: Luis Taz's Sunday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Timberline, Arcturus, Ross 154, Maplevale, Miaplacidus, Cervantes, Ridgecrest, Grumium, Celaeno, Lanternwick and Diadem; mined 2 iron ore; got into 12 fights; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Luis Taz's Wednesday night on UNDOCKED: went through Nova Terra, Sirius, Lacaille 9352, Grumium, Celaeno, Lanternwick, Diadem, Intercrus, Gsc 0044, Atlas, Cedarhold, Achernar and The Experiment; mined 9 copper ore, 2 antimatter containment cell and 4 iron ore; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

pilots.name: Lena Okafor
